sloka: पश्य लक्ष्मण वैदेह्याः स्पृहाम् उल्लसिताम् इमाम् ।रूप श्रेष्ठतया हि एष मृगो अद्य न भविष्यति ॥३-४३-२५॥
transliteration: paśya lakṣmaṇa vaidehyāḥ spṛhām ullasitām imām ।rūpa śreṣṭhatayā hi eṣa mṛgo adya na bhaviṣyati ॥3-43-25॥

translations.english: O Lakshmana, see the eagerness of Sita. Such a deer of exceptional beauty will not be found in this forest. There is no equal to this animal even in the Nandan garden of Indra, or the Chaitraratha, the garden of Kubera. Where can such an animal be found on earth?
translations.hindi: क्योंकि हे लक्ष्मण ! जब ऐसा मुग नन्दनवन ओर चैत्ररथवन ही में नहीं है, तब प्रथिवी पर ऐसा मूग मिलना तो खबंथा दुलेभ है
